prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one production game grass-card albedo cutout with real transparent background, 1024x1024 square PNG. Primary request: a naturally dense but airy tuft of fresh temperate meadow grass for Gorski Kotar, Croatia. Orthographic front elevation, no perspective, complete tuft centrally framed, root tips grouped at bottom center 4% above image edge, silhouette reaching 90% image height and 85% image width. About 50 fine green blades of varied lengths with soft arching and folded tips, shorter dense basal leaves creating a soft broad body in the lower half, a few taller delicate spear leaves, controlled asymmetry. Healthy restrained olive-sage greens, a few warm pale dry tips, no fluorescent green, no flower heads. Botanical photography surface detail but flat neutral diffuse illumination suitable for relighting as PBR albedo, no directional highlights or cast shadows. Absolutely no soil, roots below tuft, ground plane, pot, background color, checkerboard baked into pixels, text, border, or watermark. Transparent pixels between every blade and around the whole tuft. Individual blades must remain separate readable shapes at mip levels; substantial basal body without a solid wedge. This will replace a sparse wiry grass-card image, so favor a soft low meadow tussock silhouette, not a tall reed, wheat, fern, or decorative fountain grass.
performanceEvidence: meadow-paired-01: six alternating captures per view, 480 frames each, two close views. Identical draw/triangle counts; pooled median GPU changes +0.136% and +0.347%. Timing variation across repeated identical arms exceeds this difference. This does not establish performance on other adapters.
notes: Alpha mean coverage increased from 0.12262 to 0.23766. The texture remains the same size and uses the same existing SeedThree card geometry, material, slots, LOD, wind and seasonal paths.
